usage: agentware attach [-h] [--format {text,json}] --path PATH [--migrate]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --path PATH           path to the candidate KB repo to validate
  --migrate             idempotently fill missing structure first (never
                        clobbers existing data), then validate
